title: India's Renewable Energy Cost Leadership (IRENA)
summary: India's solar LCOE: $35/MWh (2025) — lower than China ($36) and Brazil ($37).

items: India's solar LCOE: $35/MWh (2025) — lower than China ($36) and Brazil ($37).
